name: 写真から検出した特徴語の縦並び
prompt: Render one Japanese Lighthouse component consisting ONLY of three detected-feature badges stacked vertically, matching Japanese mock's order and clean isolated white composition. Exact text top-to-bottom '自然な装い', 'カーディガン', '落ち着いた色'. Meiryo REGULAR14/24 role, zero tracking, thin normal dark #1D1D1D strokes, never bold. All three white-filled rounded rectangles, thin neutral #D9DEE3 outlines to define white-on-white boundary, same width and height, modest round corner radius about one-quarter of badge height as ORIGINAL white badges (not fully semicircular pill ends). Compact equal gaps, centered labels, common right/left edges, all complete and readable. Original photograph-backed badge reference controls soft rounded shape, white material and label order; native mock controls Japanese wording and straight planar vertical layout. Do NOT recreate or include any clothing photograph/texture behind badges: this isolated component scope is only three labels on pure #FFFFFF. No title, checkmark, icons, green selected state, colored fill, shadow, extra words or additional badges. Compact standalone stack, small quiet white margins, not a poster or phone screen. Neutral unselected feature words, no forced green accent.
reviewNotes: Three exact Japanese feature labels in correct order, Regular optical weight, common edges/equal gaps, soft source-style rounded rectangles with thin neutral borders on white, no unwanted green/selection/glyphs/photo reconstruction. Isolated label-only component scope respected. Raster candidate only; outer canvas differs, no actual detection, separate editable-property, exact-font, owner or runtime acceptance.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
